title: Orientation
description: auto lays the drum out as one row when the page is at least twice as wide as tall, otherwise as a column (drum on top, stats below). The layout re-flows to whatever size the page is given; short rows switch to inline labels, and narrow rows drop same hand, peak, hit strip, alternation and hand balance, in that order.

title: Alignment
description: Which side the drum sits on. Right mirrors the row (drum at the right end), for placing the overlay on the right of the screen; centre centres it in a box wider than it needs.

title: Backing
description: none floats the drum on the game with a text shadow only; scrim adds a soft dark fade behind it for bright map backgrounds; panel draws a graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: Colour of peak KPS and the hand balance fill: map takes a tonal accent from the current beatmap's background (amber when the map has none); 18-lab always uses amber. Drum zone colours are set by Colour mode.

title: Show stats
description: Show the stats beside the drum: live keys per second with the attempt's peak, left/right hand balance, the recent hits by hand, alternation rate (share of consecutive hits on opposite hands; simultaneous big-note doubles are not counted) and same-hand repeats. Off leaves the drum and its four zone counts.

title: Colour mode
description: How lit zones, count ticks and the hit strip are coloured: by note type (centre don red, rim kat blue), by hand (left blue, right amber; also colours the hand balance bar), or a single neutral tone. In the hit strip don hits are solid and kat hits hollow in every mode.
